notes.title: 1.1.63 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
​Mostly fixes of bugs you reported!

- Fixed double tap dash not working online
- Fixed crash when rebinding player 2 left dash
- Fixed video settings menu soft lock in story mode
- Fixed Discord invitation text in the online menu

notes.title: Next update
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
We thought it's been a while we hadn't posted anything on here.
So just letting you know, the next update is almost complete, there's just one nasty bug in there and then we'll release it.

Briefly, it will include among other things :
- REBINDS, FUCKING REBINDS (This is where there's one last bug)
- A bit of balancing
- More accessibility options
- Some achievements & seasonal events were not triggering correctly so we fixed those
- Random stage on online lobby creation
- Made weather effects togglable and less frequent
- Sound when a player joins a room
- Disabled cheats online for those who might have tried using them
- Fixed stage selection settings
- Removed the annoying scarf online
- General polish & bug fixes

I promise we're doing what we can to fix this last thing. (Basically rebinds only work if you restart the game, so I guess in the worst-case scenario we can just release it like that...)

Once that's done GOG and itch.io will have the online mode arriving soon
Thanks for your support, stay tuned

notes.title: 1.1.44 balancing update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, before bug fixes for the online mode and an upcoming tournament we wanted to update a bit of the game's balancing after the community's feedback and our feelings about the characters.

IZANAGI
- Increased attack range a bit
- Increased parry recovery speed
- Made stomp anim faster
- Increased a bit stomp range
- Sped up a bit Perfect Parry anim

SUSANOO
- Increased a bit invulnerability duration on dashes. i-frames also start earlier now
- Sped up a bit kick anim startup
- Sped up a bit attack animations

JINMU
- Removed i-frames on his neutral attack
- Reduced a bit light attack range

MASKED RONIN
- Increased a bit pommel strike range

OTHER STUFF
- Changed parry stamina recovery to be 3 bars instead of 2
- Changed stamina break to be 1 bar instead of 2

Hopefully, these will make the game feel more balanced and all options worth it. Let us know your thoughts when playing this new version, thanks !
